notes.content:
v0.4.9 is here:
New Content chapter started: LARGE Map - Battle for Midway!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38796853/682152f71425ce6f7499bc8a0a1b9a744914548b.png
Few improvements
Few small tweaks
Sound volume tweaks
Bugfixing: fixed fire FX causing units to deselect and no longer selectable.

UPDATE v0.5.0
Fixed Save-game
Fixed Map Crete (AI uiti exiting playiable area)
Removed the "Surrender" button

Update v0.5.1
Fixed map It_Offensive - units retreating into water tiles
Fixed units hidden in clouds

Update v0.5.3
Bug-fixing for "Cannot select unit"
Small tweaks
Increased reinforcement cap to 10

Update v0.5.4
Bug-fixing
Rebalancing AI Support mechanic from being over-used (game-flow improved)
                                       
Update v0.5.6-6
Unit tweaks
Added Mobile Supply H.Q in most maps
Increased Supply cap to 25(both player and AI) units can get back to full strength easy.                                                            
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38796853/90b5e7446e5713b570179b7106f53d8fde8c68b3.png

Update v0.5.7
Added Camera controls 
Right Click to deselect units
Shortcuts: Escape(menu), Tab(Recruit) 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9 to recruit a specific unit.

Cheers!
